name: SUCHI
bio: SUCHI is a DJ and producer with Indian and Norwegian heritage whose formative raving experiences in Oslo, London and New York underpin an intentionally global-inspired club vision. Her distinct sound is best experienced in dynamic sets infused with house, percussion, bass, and techno with a flair for the experimental. Named one of the top 25 artists to watch by Mixmag and one of the 12 artists you need to listen to in 2022 by DJ Mag. Championed by Pitchfork, Vogue, Rolling Stone, Wired, and Electronic Beats. In 2025, she launched her own imprint Ikke Sant (Norwegian for "isn't that right?"). The debut release, Sub Cut EP, delivers three tracks of psychedelic, hypnotic club music. Support from Ben UFO, Pearson Sound, Midland, Pariah, Or:la, Ciel, Florentino, DJ JM, Peder Mannerfelt, HAAi, and Bradley Zero. Noted appearances at Fabric, Phonox, Warehouse Project, Glastonbury, By:Larm, Sonar Festival, Waterworks, Magnetic Fields and ADE. Two landmark broadcasts for Boiler Room (India tour with Parris and Nikki Nair). Australian tour supporting Jon Hopkins. Recorded mixes for DJ Mag, NTS Radio, BBC Radio 6 and HÖR. In 2026, performing at Cadavra in City Center on June 6, 2026.

name: NIKKI NAIR
bio: Nikki Nair is an Atlanta, Georgia-based producer and DJ of Indian-American heritage who has become one of the most booked Indian-origin electronic artists in the global underground. His productions merge electro, leftfield techno, breaks, bass, and ghettotech into colourful, twisted dancefloor hybrids. He is known for bombastic, unexpected DJ sets that refuse genre boundaries, flipping between ghettotech, UKG, experimental disco, and beyond. Formerly based in Knoxville, Tennessee, he moved to Atlanta during the pandemic and left his day job in December 2022 to focus on music full-time. He launched his own label "n goes to infinity" in 2022, focused on releases between underground club music and American-style bass music. In 2023, he released the mini-album "Set the Roof" with his personal hero Hudson Mohawke. Named one of Mixmag's top 25 artists to watch and one of DJ Mag's 12 artists you need to listen to in 2022. Championed by Crack Magazine as one of the artists who defined 2023.

name: INDO WAREHOUSE
bio: Indo Warehouse is a record label and experiential series founded by Kunal Merchant and Kahani (Armaan Gupta) that showcases the beauty of South Asian culture, music, and rhythm within the global language of electronic music. They coined the genre "Indo House", fusing deep techno beats with South Asian classical influences. In just three years, they moved from intimate New York clubs to sold-out international venues across Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. Their performances feature up to 25 performers including musicians, vocalists, and dancers. Historic Coachella 2025 debut as first South Asian electronic collective. Performed at Hï Ibiza, F1 Singapore, DGTL, Magnetic Fields, and Lollapalooza.

name: PRISMER
bio: Prismer is Rohan Kale, a New Delhi producer and DJ making explorative, bass-driven electronic music that runs from techno and jungle to house, dubstep, breakbeat and disco. He first got into electronic music in London in 2010. His early releases came out on Boxout.FM, Reel Long Overdub and Tokyo Hell. He has shared stages with DJ Stingray, Pangaea, Denham Audio, Ivy Lab and Rider Shafique, and played Magnetic Fields, Bass Camp, Grasslands (Nepal) and Boiler Room Delhi NCR (June 2024). He played The Warehouse Project India in October 2025; his Mumbai set came out on Apple Music. He started the Delhi party series Mixed Feelings, made as a safe space for marginalised communities.
